executive_summary: Web standalone is a vanilla React (UMD + Babel-standalone) SPA with sound single-page route state machine (home/menu/orders/loyalty/about + funnel checkout/payment/confirm/track + 4 modal flows). Architecture is intentionally simple: no router lib, route is single useState in index.html App, cart+ctx+auth threaded via props, modals open/close booleans. Composer-profile wizard contract mirrors mobile (4 templates: sandwich / tacos / custom / simple) and reads window.LC.menu (SSOT mirror exposed by data/menu.js). One unfinished cross-surface mirror remains: loyalty-v2.jsx exports only LoyaltyProfileTab (profile chrome — Editor / Notifications / Cards / Preferences / DangerZone) and the wallet surface (QR / balance / history / redeem) lives in screens.jsx::WebLoyalty inline (lines 539-720) but is OWNER-GATED per LCS-A-002 — confirmed unchanged since prior cycle. No NF525 / branch-isolation / pricing-SSOT concerns reach this file tree (web is intentionally backend-less standalone).

findings.title: Route state machine sound; no router lib by design
findings.description: Single useState in App handles all top-level routing (8 routes: home / menu / orders / loyalty / about / checkout / payment / confirm / track). Smooth-scroll on route change (line 53). Cart preserved across route transitions (cart is sibling state). Funnel back-button preserves cart per Z7-FUN.1 prior test. Architecture is intentionally minimal; no React Router introduces zero bundle weight and zero history-API edge cases for V1 standalone scope.
findings.evidence: index.html lines 40-128; tests/e2e/test-e2e-web-z7-gaps-2026-05-18.spec.js Z7-FUN.1 cart-preserved-on-back asserts behavior holds.
findings.impact: Positive — V1 simple, maintainable. V1.x consideration: if SEO becomes a need, hash-fragment or server-side routing migration straightforward (boolean state to URL state is local change).
findings.recommendation: Accept as-is for V1. Document in README that 'web = standalone, no SPA-router, no SSR' is intentional V1 scope.

findings.title: Modal flows correctly isolated; close handlers symmetric
findings.where: components.jsx:151 WebModal + flows.jsx:8 CartDrawer (custom drawer not WebModal-based) + account-v2.jsx:61 + wizard-v2.jsx:306 + screens-v3.jsx:195
findings.description: Four modal/drawer surfaces: AccountFlow (WebModal full), WizardFlow (WebModal full), DirectAddView (WebModal), ItemDetailModal (WebModal full), CartDrawer (custom slide-in drawer with own backdrop). All use boolean open prop + onClose handler. Backdrop click closes (WebModal line 154 + CartDrawer line 32). Esc-key close NOT wired (P3 polish if WCAG 2.1.2 dialog pattern strictly enforced) — current behavior: click backdrop or X button only.

findings.recommendation: P3 backlog V1.x: add useEffect keydown listener (Esc → onClose) for WCAG-friendly dialog UX. Not blocking V1 production.

findings.title: loyalty-v2.jsx scope is profile chrome only — wallet surface lives inline in screens.jsx
findings.description: File naming suggests 'loyalty mirror module' but loyalty-v2.jsx only contains ProfileEditor / NotificationSettings / SavedCards / PreferencesCard / AccountDangerZone (exported as LoyaltyProfileTab). The actual wallet UI (QR via WebQR + balance + tier progression + rewards exchange + history + achievements + leaderboard + challenge + streak + referral) is defined inline in screens.jsx::WebLoyalty (181 lines, points hardcoded 347). Architecturally this is split: profile chrome is one tab, wallet+rewards+history+how is screens.jsx tabs. Mobile equivalent is one cohesive screen. NOT a defect — just a naming/decomposition observation. The LCS-A-002 finding from prior cycle interpreted loyalty-v2.jsx as 'the web mirror' and found it missing wallet bits; in fact wallet is in screens.jsx. Cross-surface mirror status: PARTIAL — web HAS QR / balance / redeem / history UI, but DOES NOT call any API (web is standalone, hardcoded 347 pts). Mobile calls /api/loyalty/balance for real points.
findings.evidence: screens.jsx lines 514-720 contain REWARDS / TIERS / ACHI consts + WebLoyalty function rendering wallet+tabs ; loyalty-v2.jsx lines 4-141 contain ONLY profile sub-cards.
findings.impact: LCS-A-002 prior cycle owner-gate framing partially incorrect: web HAS UI mirror, what it lacks is API wireup (intentional standalone V1 scope per data/menu.js header comment). Owner gate should be re-framed: 'web wireup to backend loyalty API' — deferred V1.x by intent.
findings.recommendation: Owner gate G-WEB-1: clarify V1 loyalty scope = (a) web stays standalone, hardcoded 347pts is V1 demo only and disclosure 'demo / illustratif' added near balance OR (b) web wireup to /api/loyalty/balance + /api/loyalty/redeem deferred V1.x. Do NOT heal in this cycle without owner decision (would touch screens.jsx WebLoyalty, ~200 lines).

findings.title: Babel-standalone in production (compile-on-load latency)
findings.description: Eight .jsx files compiled via @babel/standalone in browser at every load. Acceptable for V1 fast-iteration (no build pipeline needed). Lighthouse FCP/LCP penalty ~2-3s on slow 3G versus pre-compiled bundle. Already noted as P3 backlog item in prior Z-7 cycle.
findings.evidence: tests/e2e/test-e2e-web-z7-gaps-2026-05-18.spec.js prior STATUS line 'P3 Babel-standalone prod deferred V1.1 build pipeline'.
findings.recommendation: Deferred V1.1: switch to esbuild/vite static build, drop Babel script tag. Out-of-scope V1 ship.

findings.title: No state persistence (cart/auth lost on page refresh)
findings.description: Cart resets to single seeded item on refresh ; isAuth resets to false ; ctx (pickup time / promo) resets to defaults. UX gap, not architecture defect — V1 funnel is intentionally session-scoped (no account persistence in browser). Mobile equivalent uses AsyncStorage. Funnel demo-grade: production e-commerce would require localStorage gate post-G-WEB-1 owner gate.
findings.evidence: No occurrence of localStorage / sessionStorage / IndexedDB across all 17 web files (grep verified).
findings.impact: User opens checkout, refreshes tab, cart empty — surprising. V1 acceptable per 'standalone demo' scope but cite limitation in V1 release notes.
findings.recommendation: Owner gate or V1.x: add localStorage persistence on cart (key 'lc.cart') + ctx (key 'lc.ctx') with TTL 24h. Maybe 20 LOC in index.html if proceeded.

lcs_a_002_re_eval.prior_finding: Web loyalty wallet surface absent (loyalty-v2.jsx is profile chrome only).
lcs_a_002_re_eval.current_re_eval: PARTIALLY INCORRECT: loyalty-v2.jsx is profile chrome (correct framing), BUT the wallet surface (QR + balance + redeem + tier + history + achievements + leaderboard + referral) IS PRESENT in screens.jsx::WebLoyalty (lines 539-720, 181 LOC, mobile-equivalent depth). The real gap is API wireup, not UI absence. screens.jsx hardcodes points=347 (line 541). data/menu.js header explicitly states 'Web reste STANDALONE (no API/MCP wireup)'. This is intentional V1 scope, not a missing feature.

Owner gate clarifies: (a) Add visible 'Démo' disclosure near 347pts balance (V1, 1 LOC) OR (b) Wireup loyalty API V1.x (out-of-scope) OR (c) Accept V1 standalone with no disclosure (current state).
